title: LightFuse: relightable multi-scan Gaussian reconstruction with 2DGS ray tracing
summary: MrNeRF presents LightFuse for relightable multi-scan interactive Gaussian reconstruction with material–illumination decomposition, reporting +9.74 dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM over the strongest baseline on synthetic scenes.
question_it_answers: How does LightFuse achieve relightable multi-scan Gaussian scene reconstruction?

claims.text: LightFuse is presented as the first framework for relightable multi-scan interactive Gaussian reconstruction with explicit material–illumination decomposition.
claims.evidence: the first framework for relightable multi-scan interactive Gaussian reconstruction with explicit material–illumination decomposition.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: Staged inverse rendering surpasses the strongest baseline by +9.74 dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM on average across synthetic scenes.
claims.evidence: surpassing the strongest baseline by +9.74 dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM on average.
